model: KN2 / KN4 / rAy boilers - HeatNet BACnet Bridge
applies_to: Hydrotherm (Mestek) KN2 and KN4 boilers and rAy boilers with a HeatNet control and a HeatNet BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP bridge (bridge configuration 2.40+).
summary: On Hydrotherm KN2, KN4 and rAy boilers the HeatNet control is linked to BACnet through a HeatNet bridge that translates its Modbus registers into a fixed object list. The BMS writes heat demand, the system setpoint (with a countdown failsafe timer), outdoor-reset settings, DHW setpoint and the clock. Read-only objects give plant temperatures, boilers on, modulation, raw spare inputs and per-boiler run time, cycles, temperatures, modulation and status flags for up to 16 boilers.
firmware: Bridge configuration 2.40+ (2.50+ for some points); HeatNet firmware 2.70 / 3.48+ for some points
notes: Per-boiler binary values are printed once as Boiler##_<name> with an instance formula and are listed here at the boiler 1 instance: 1000-series base + (n - 1) x 32, 2000/3000-series base + (n - 1) x 16. Boiler 1 is the master or stand-alone boiler; members are 2-16.

Per-boiler analog inputs are printed as ranges and listed here for boiler 1 only: Runtime AI 48-63, Cycles AI 64-79, SupplyTemp AI 80-95, ReturnTemp AI 96-111, DHWTemp AI 112-127, Modulation AI 128-143 (boiler n = boiler 1 instance + n - 1).
Bridge configuration 2.50+ is needed for AV 15 (with HeatNet firmware 2.70+) and for AI 112-144 and BV 3000-3011 (with HeatNet firmware 3.48+).

This list has fewer per-boiler flags than the KNSX and KN HeatNet V3 lists (no LWCO, VFD, gas-prove or operator interlocks), and adds BV 3004-3008 (blocked inlet/flue, DHW input, low-fire input, DHW fault).
The document describes Boiler##_OutsideSensorNA with the same text as HeaderSensorNA ('Header Sensor not available'); the name suggests the outside sensor.

integration.summary: Connect the BMS to the master (boiler 1) HeatNet control. Write BV 1 HeatDemand to call for heat and AV 2 Setpoint for the system setpoint, and keep reloading AV 1 SetpointTimer so the plant does not fall back to its local setpoint. Read header/supply/return temperatures, boilers on, modulation and the per-boiler alarm and failed flags.

minimum_points.name: HeatDemand
minimum_points.why: Heat demand from the BMS (1 = heat)

minimum_points.name: SetpointTimer
minimum_points.why: Failsafe countdown; reload before it reaches 0

integration.enable: BV 1 HeatDemand puts the boiler (plant) into heating mode when set to 1; 0 removes the demand. The setpoint the BMS writes is AV 2 Setpoint.
integration.heartbeat: AV 1 SetpointTimer (0-65535 s) is a BMS failsafe countdown. The BMS must reload it periodically; if it reaches zero the control assumes the BMS has stopped and reloads its own saved local setpoint. Writing any read/write variable reloads the timer to 60 s if it is below 60 (on control firmware below 2.70 only writing the setpoint does this).
integration.remote_sensors: AV 3-7 and BV 2 set up outdoor air reset; there is no writable outdoor temperature or flow value on this bridge.
setup: The HeatNet bridge comes as a BACnet IP or a BACnet MS/TP version (an extra-cost option); it translates the HeatNet Modbus registers to these objects.
BACnet IP bridge defaults, from Mestek's separate 'HeatNet Communication Protocols' v1.01 document (not the object list): IP 192.168.1.24, mask 255.255.255.0, BACnet MAC 11, BACnet node 11.
BACnet MS/TP bridge defaults (same HeatNet Communication Protocols document): MAC 11, BACnet node 11, 38400 baud.
To set the clock, write AV 8-14 (month, day, year, hour, minute, second, weekday) and then write 1 to BV 3 SetClock.
gotchas: If SetpointTimer runs out, the plant quietly returns to its local setpoint.
Per-boiler objects are listed at the boiler 1 instance; offset them by boiler number using the formulas in the notes. Boiler 1 is the master or stand-alone boiler.
Per-boiler modulation (AI 128-143) does not work in AA/High Fire, T1 or T2 modes.
The bridge polls the HeatNet Modbus registers continuously; a few less important registers are not carried over to BACnet.

points.name: SetpointTimer
points.description: BMS failsafe countdown; reload before it reaches zero; 0 – 65535 seconds

points.name: Setpoint
points.description: System setpoint written by the BMS; 40 - 220 °F (4.5 – 104.4 °C)

points.name: OARSetpoint
points.description: Outdoor temperature at which the boiler shuts down; 40 – 100 °F (4.5 – 37.8 °C)

points.name: OARHighWaterTemp
points.description: Water setpoint at the high outdoor temperature; 60 – 190 °F (15.6 – 87.8 °C)

points.name: OARHighAirTemp
points.description: High outdoor air temperature reset point; 50 – 90 °F (10 – 32.2 °C)

points.name: OARLowWaterTemp
points.description: Header/supply setpoint at the low outdoor temperature; 70 – 220 °F (21.1 – 104.4 °C)

points.name: OARLowAirTemp
points.description: Low outdoor air temperature reset point; -35 – 40 °F (-37.2 – 4.4 °C)

points.name: HeatDemand
points.description: BMS heat demand: 1 puts the boiler plant into heating

points.name: SetClock
points.description: Write 1 to load the Set... values into the clock

points.name: Boiler##_DHWSensorEnabled
points.description: DHW Sensor has been enabled in the menus

points.name: Boiler##_OpLimitClamp
points.description: Boiler input is limited (clamped) due to high supply (outlet) temperature

points.name: Spare1
points.description: Raw A/D value of spare input 1

points.name: Spare2
points.description: Raw A/D value of spare input 2

points.name: Boiler01_Runtime
points.description: Boiler 1 run time on the current board (boiler n = 47 + n)

points.name: Boiler01_DHWTemp
points.description: Boiler 1 DHW sensor temperature (boiler n = 111 + n)

points.name: OperatingSetpoint
points.description: Active setpoint in use (heating, DHW, reset or 4-20 mA)
